policy: No user-facing numeric claim is permitted without a validated canonical qualification artifact.

claims.claim_text: The retained frozen M0 baseline achieved 66.64% exact match on all 1,319 protected GSM8K test examples.
claims.qualification: Evaluator-only v3 rescore of complete, hash-frozen v2 generation outputs; exact normalized numeric/string matching.
claims.prohibited_stronger_claim: Do not call this symbolic mathematical accuracy or claim independent v3 model generation.

claims.claim_text: A rank-32 attention+MLP LoRA challenger was rejected after protected GSM8K exact match fell from 66.64% to 49.43% (-17.21 pp; paired 95% bootstrap CI [-20.24, -14.18]).
claims.qualification: All 1,319 paired GSM8K test examples; 20,000 paired bootstrap resamples; deterministic frozen v2 outputs re-scored by the corrected v3 parser.
claims.prohibited_stronger_claim: Do not claim LoRA improved quality or that the result generalizes beyond this checkpoint, prompt, parser, and dataset.

claims.claim_text: The LoRA challenger also regressed on the complete MATH-500 OOD check: 18.80% versus 29.80% for M0 (-11.00 pp; paired 95% CI [-14.80, -7.00]).
claims.qualification: All 500 MATH-500 examples; conservative normalized final-answer exact match, not symbolic equivalence.
claims.prohibited_stronger_claim: Do not describe 29.80% as canonical MATH-500 accuracy or claim symbolic-equivalence evaluation.

claims.claim_text: Dynamic padding plus torch.compile increased median paired steady-state training throughput by 348.51% versus the frozen BF16 eager fixed-width baseline (95% paired bootstrap interval 157.26% to 588.82%).
claims.qualification: Three paired fresh-process replicates on one RTX 4090 Laptop GPU; 35,382 identical non-padding tokens per run; synchronized BF16 steps; material run-order/thermal association and wide interval must be disclosed.
claims.prohibited_stronger_claim: Do not claim a hardware-independent 4.5x speedup, omit the n=3/order qualifier, or apply this result to other models or sequence distributions.

claims.claim_text: For the fixed 378-step workload, T4 reduced median projected wall time including measured cold overhead by 41.87%; the median paired compile break-even was 173 steps.
claims.qualification: Projection from measured first-step/compiler overhead and measured steady mean step time; not a directly timed 378-step end-to-end run. Pairwise break-even range was 75 to 270 steps.
claims.prohibited_stronger_claim: Do not describe the projected wall-time reduction as a directly measured full-training runtime reduction.

claims.claim_text: T4 reduced median peak allocated training VRAM by 34.29%, from 12,108 MiB to 7,956 MiB, under the frozen workload.
claims.qualification: PyTorch peak allocated memory on one RTX 4090 Laptop GPU; three runs per configuration; fixed model, data, global batch, and measured tokens.
claims.prohibited_stronger_claim: Do not equate allocated-memory reduction with total system VRAM or generalize to other accelerators.

claims.claim_text: At the frozen ScaleForge SLO-compliant concurrency-2 operating point, vLLM increased median successful serving throughput by 71.39%, from 0.1208 to 0.2070 requests/s (95% paired three-replicate bootstrap interval 51.01% to 89.52%).
claims.qualification: Three fresh-server replicates per runtime on one RTX 4090 Laptop GPU; identical 64-request POLICY corpus, model, prompt, tokenizer, 512-token cap, and deterministic decoding; all frozen request-path gates passed.
claims.prohibited_stronger_claim: Do not call this a production throughput guarantee, omit n=3/laptop/prefix-cache qualifiers, claim vLLM V2, or generalize beyond this workload and hardware.

claims.claim_text: At concurrency 2, vLLM reduced p95 time per output token by 65.19% and p95 end-to-end latency by 34.75%, while increasing p95 TTFT from 86.86 ms to 443.24 ms.
claims.qualification: Hierarchical request-within-replicate bootstrap; p95 TTFT point estimate passes the frozen 500 ms bound, but its 95% interval is 404.74 to 527.72 ms and crosses that bound.
claims.prohibited_stronger_claim: Do not claim vLLM improved every latency metric or that TTFT met the frozen bound with 95% confidence.

claims.claim_text: All 2,304 measured serving qualification requests succeeded across 36 frozen HF/vLLM operating points.
claims.qualification: Request-path success only. vLLM exhibited a repeatable post-measurement EngineCore force-kill and leaked semaphore during shutdown.
claims.prohibited_stronger_claim: Do not claim the service lifecycle was failure-free or production-ready.

claims.claim_text: Two-GPU DDP speedup and scaling efficiency were not locally qualified because only one physical CUDA GPU was available.
claims.qualification: Implementation and CPU/Gloo launch behavior are tested; no two-GPU CUDA execution occurred.
claims.prohibited_stronger_claim: Do not state or imply any measured distributed speedup, scaling efficiency, communication overhead, or multi-GPU memory result.
